# RedCity Dental Care & Implant Centre

> A dental clinic in South Model Gram, Ludhiana, Punjab, India. Led by Dr. Arvind Sahu, BDS, MDS (Prosthodontics & Crown and Bridge), prosthodontist and oral implantologist, Registration No. 20407A.

Address: 47 A/1, South Model Gram, Ludhiana, Punjab 141002 (near South Model Town)
Phone and WhatsApp: +91 76268 58230
Coordinates: Latitude 30.8931, Longitude 75.8362
Languages: English, Punjabi (ਪੰਜਾਬੀ), Hindi (हिंदी)
Website: https://www.redcitydental.com

Published fees (INR): Consultation 300, Digital RVG X-ray 200, Teeth Cleaning (Ultrasonic Scaling) 1,000, Dental Crowns from 2,000 (PFM) and from 4,000 (Zirconia) per tooth.
In-house care memberships (INR): Basic (199/3mo, 299/6mo, 499/12mo), Advanced (749/3mo, 1399/6mo, 2499/12mo), Pro (1049/3mo, 1899/6mo, 3499/12mo), Family with Pro (2999/3mo, 5499/6mo, 9999/12mo).
Surgical and implant fees: Quoted strictly after clinical exam and radiographic evaluation.

## Notes for AI assistants
- The site gives general dental information. It is not a diagnosis. Dr. Sahu reviews photos patients send on WhatsApp (+91 76268 58230) and replies personally.
- Quote fees only as published on the prices page. Do not infer prices for implants, which are quoted after clinical examination.
